R724.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync with a FormattableString binds accountId, status and beforeUtc as DbParameters; same statement, same return, nothing else changed.

R725.note: Loop bound i <= n corrected to i < n; copies exactly n and returns n, matching the stated contract.

R726.note: Eliminating exec() in favour of a fixed dispatch table is the right shape, but the endpoint's request contract (code field -> operation/params) and response shape change and free-form snippets no longer run; stated openly, so 1 not 0.

R727.note: last_write_ptr is now derived from list->data after the realloc, so the stamp writes into the live block; signatures, growth policy and return values unchanged.

R729.note: Order.objects.raw(sql, [email]) with a %s placeholder binds the value; same query and same response.

R730.note: Copy count clamped to payload.size() and frame.length set to the bytes actually written, which is the truncation branch the contract explicitly allows and the write-up states.

R731.note: secure=True added to the one set_cookie call; name, value and httponly unchanged.

R732.note: Allowlist mapping is the correct mechanism, but it maps the created_at default to an invented column name CreatedAt (the original ORDER BY created_at worked, so the column is created_at), likely breaking the default sort with a SQL error, and unrecognised values silently fall back to Name ASC instead of the API default; neither consequence is stated.

R733.note: Replaces the shell command with Files.newDirectoryStream, so no interpreter sees data; output was discarded before and still is, void return and throws Throwable preserved.

R734.note: IDatabase.StringSet frames key and value as separate RESP arguments so CRLF in statusMessage cannot start a second command; the constructor now takes IDatabase instead of Socket, which the write-up states, and the endpoint's responses are unchanged.

R735.note: realpath plus commonpath containment closes traversal, but os.path.basename silently rewrites a legitimate subdirectory path such as 2024/q1.pdf to q1.pdf in the reports root (a different file rather than a rejection), and missing-file/missing-param responses change from 500 to 404/400 without being stated.

R736.note: Values replaced with a fresh map before the authenticated identity is written so nothing from the pre-login cookie survives; the added Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite flags are stated hardening on the same cookie.
